summary: Correction to Aberdeen control area 3 lateral limits, as the online aeronautical information publication contains errors.
text:
UK AIP AIRAC 12/2026 AVAILABLE AT
HTTPS://WWW.AURORA.NATS.CO.UK/HTMLAIP/PUBLICATIONS/
2026-11-26-AIRAC/HTML/INDEX-EN-GB.HTML CONTAINS ERRONEOUS
INFORMATION. PLEASE AMEND ABERDEEN CTA 3 LATERAL LIMITS TO READ:
572100N 0023356W THENCE ANTI-CLOCKWISE BY THE ARC OF A CIRCLE
RADIUS 10NM CENTRED ON 571834N 0021602W TO 571519N 0023327W -
570214N 0022458W THENCE ANTI-CLOCKWISE BY THE ARC OF A CIRCLE
